## Top Platform Recommendations for a 3–4 Minute Promotional Video

The key constraint here is **video length**. Many popular AI video tools (Sora, Runway) generate clips of only 16–20 seconds, which means a 3–4 minute video requires stitching dozens of clips together. The platforms below are specifically suited for longer-form, script-driven professional video.

---

### #1 — HeyGen *(Best Overall for This Use Case)*
**[heygen.com](https://www.heygen.com)**

HeyGen is the strongest match for the PropertyMax.ai video. It is purpose-built for **script-to-video with an AI avatar presenter**, which mirrors the professional talking-head style of the NotebookLM video. There is no hard clip length limit — the avatar reads your full script from start to finish in a single render.

| Feature | Detail |
|---|---|
| Video Length | Unlimited (avatar-driven, full script) |
| Quality | 1080p standard, 4K on Business plan |
| Script-to-Video | Yes — paste the full script and it generates end-to-end |
| AI Avatar | 1,100+ professional presenters |
| Voiceover | AI voice cloning in 175+ languages |
| Pricing | Free (3 videos/mo) → Creator $24/mo → Business $149/mo |
| Best For | Professional business promotional video with a presenter |

**Why it wins for PropertyMax.ai:** You can paste the entire 5-scene script, select a professional-looking avatar, and it renders a polished, full-length video. The Business plan also supports team collaboration and 4K export — ideal for displaying on those 4-panel TV walls.

---

### #2 — InVideo AI *(Best for Script + Stock Footage Style)*
**[invideo.io](https://invideo.io)**

InVideo AI is the best option if you want a **cinematic montage style** — like a corporate brand video with voiceover narration over stock footage and motion graphics — rather than a talking-head presenter. You paste a long script, and it automatically finds matching stock clips, adds music, subtitles, and transitions.

| Feature | Detail |
|---|---|
| Video Length | No hard limit — handles full 3–4 minute scripts |
| Style | Stock footage + voiceover + motion graphics |
| Script-to-Video | Yes — full script input with scene-by-scene generation |
| Voiceover | AI voice or upload your own |
| Pricing | Free (watermarked) → Plus $25/mo → Max $60/mo |
| Best For | Cinematic brand/promo video with narration over visuals |

**Why it's great for PropertyMax.ai:** The 5-scene script maps perfectly to InVideo AI's scene-by-scene workflow. Each `[SCENE]` block becomes a segment. The visual direction notes in the script serve as prompts for each scene.

---

### #3 — Pictory AI *(Best for Script-to-Video Simplicity)*
**[pictory.ai](https://pictory.ai)**

Pictory has a dedicated **"Script to Video"** feature that is among the simplest to use. You paste your script, it auto-matches stock footage, adds captions, and generates a professional video. It is slightly less cinematic than InVideo but extremely fast and clean.

| Feature | Detail |
|---|---|
| Video Length | Up to 10 minutes per video |
| Style | Stock footage + captions + voiceover |
| Script-to-Video | Yes — dedicated feature |
| Pricing | Starter $25/mo → Professional $49/mo → Teams $119/mo |
| Best For | Quick, clean promotional videos from a written script |

---

### #4 — Runway Gen-4 *(Best for Cinematic AI-Generated Visuals)*
**[runwayml.com](https://runwayml.com)**

If you want **fully AI-generated cinematic visuals** (not stock footage), Runway is the filmmaker's choice. However, each clip is limited to 16 seconds, so a 3–4 minute video requires generating ~15–20 individual clips and stitching them together in an editor like CapCut or DaVinci Resolve.

| Feature | Detail |
|---|---|
| Clip Length | Up to 16 seconds per generation |
| Quality | Up to 4K upscale |
| Style | Fully AI-generated cinematic footage |
| Pricing | Standard $15/mo (125 credits) → Pro $35/mo |
| Best For | Filmmakers who want stunning AI visuals and are comfortable editing |
| Limitation | Requires manual stitching for 3–4 min video |

## The Verdict: What I Recommend for PropertyMax.ai

Given that the goal is a **professional, boss-ready promotional video** that can be produced quickly and displayed on 4-panel TVs in a conference room, here is the recommended path:

> **Use HeyGen for the presenter/narration layer + InVideo AI for the cinematic B-roll scenes.**
